scenes.headline: 3 AI VIDEO TOOLS, *ACTUALLY FREE*
scenes.sub: We checked the real daily limits
scenes.say: Okay, three AI video generators that are actually free, and I checked the real limits so you don't get burned.

scenes.headline: #3 *SEEDANCE 2.0*
scenes.say: Number three is Seedance 2.0 on Dreamina, which gives you free credits every day, but your downloads come with a watermark.

scenes.headline: #2 *GOOGLE FLOW*
scenes.say: Number two, Google Flow: you get fifty free credits a day, and that's about five short Veo clips.
That's straight from Google's help page, and at peak hours, free users might not get any videos at all.

scenes.headline: #1 *WAN 2.2*
scenes.sub: Open source: no credits at all
scenes.say: And number one is Wan 2.2: it's open source, so no credits at all, as long as you've got a {24|twenty-four} gigabyte GPU.
The catch? Free credits never roll over, and free Flow can't upscale to {1080p|ten-eighty p}, so only Wan is truly unlimited.
So which one are you trying first? Comment {FREE|free}.

verify_before_render: DONE 2026-10-09: support.google.com/flow/answer/16526234: 'With or without a subscription, you receive 50 Google Flow credits per day'; unused daily credits don't roll over; Veo 3.1 Lite = 10 credits per generation for non-Ultra users (4/6/8 s); 1080p upscaling not available to non-subscribers; 'During peak hours, roughly 2 PM to 5 PM UTC, you may not be able to generate videos without a subscription.'

DONE 2026-10-09: dreamina.capcut.com/tools/seedance-2-0 (ByteDance, official): 'You can try Dreamina Seedance 2.0 using free daily credits'; every paid plan lists 'Remove the Dreamina watermark in downloads' (free downloads are watermarked). Daily amount not published on the page.
DONE 2026-10-09: github.com/Wan-Video/Wan2.2: Apache-2.0 (GitHub API), 17,806 stars; README: TI2V-5B 720P at 24 FPS, 'can run on a GPU with at least 24GB VRAM (e.g, RTX 4090 GPU)'.

DONE 2026-10-09: footage = official samples: Google DeepMind Veo page covers (storage.googleapis.com), Dreamina Seedance 2.0 page videos (capcutcdn), Wan2.2 README demo. Avoided Dreamina samples with third-party IP (Stranger Things, Encanto-like).
